hero.title: Build forms that think beyond questions.
hero.text: Create intelligent surveys with conditional flows, automated scoring, personalized outcomes and powerful analytics, all in one platform.
hero.tagline: Flexible forms. Smarter logic. Deeper insights.

mock.whatHoping: What are you hoping to achieve?
mock.exportDoneText: Background jobs stay available to retry.

problem.title: More than forms. Build experiences that adapt.
problem.text: Traditional forms collect answers. Quorvia helps you create experiences that respond to them.

static.title: Static forms are limited
static.text: The same linear questions reach everyone, whether they are relevant or not.

logic.title: Logic changes everything
logic.text: Show, hide and route questions based on the answers that matter.

outcomes.title: Answers become outcomes
outcomes.text: Score, categorize and tailor the end screen to every completed response.

builder.title: Everything you need to build powerful forms.
builder.text: Create flexible surveys with an intuitive drag-and-drop builder, welcome and end screens, and {{count}} purposeful question types.

logicSection.title: Every answer can change what happens next.
logicSection.text: Build intelligent survey flows with flexible conditions and personalized respondent journeys, with clear paths from the first answer to the final outcome.
logicSection.caption: Create confident branching for question visibility, conditional end screens, redirects and complex decision paths.

scoring.title: Turn answers into meaningful results.
scoring.text: Assign points, calculate scores and deliver configurable result categories for assessments and qualification flows.
scoring.endTitle: A result that feels made for them.
scoring.endText: Guide people to the next step with outcomes tailored to their answers and score.

control.title: Stay in control of every response.
control.text: Manage limits, preserve respondent progress and validate submissions reliably.

quotas.title: Smart quotas
quotas.text: Limit responses for defined groups, with clear warnings while people are still answering.

autosave.title: Autosaved attempts
autosave.text: Respondents can resume unfinished attempts and use a review screen before they submit.

validation.title: Reliable validation
validation.text: Keep rules, answers and quota logic consistent between the form and the server.

analytics.title: Understand every answer. Discover every path.
analytics.text: Explore completion funnels, question-level insights and the actual paths respondents take through your surveys.
analytics.note: Don't just see what people answered. Understand how they got there.

languages.title: One form. Multiple languages.
languages.heading: One consistent experience in every language.
languages.text: Create a form in your primary language, add up to {{count}} translations and keep each version in sync with clear missing-translation indicators.
languages.c1: Language detection from the URL or browser

exports.title: Your survey data, ready when you need it.
exports.text: Export collected responses and analytical data in the formats you need.

useCases.title: One platform. Many possibilities.
useCases.text: Build surveys and dynamic forms for the decisions that matter most.

lead.title: Lead qualification
lead.text: Identify high-value prospects with conditional questions and scoring.

quiz.title: Quizzes and assessments
quiz.text: Evaluate responses, calculate scores and generate personalized results.

feedback.title: Customer feedback
feedback.text: Collect feedback, measure satisfaction and understand respondent journeys.

recruit.title: Recruitment and evaluation
recruit.text: Create structured questionnaires and assess candidates using scoring rules.

s1.title: Build
s1.text: Create a survey with the visual builder and {{count}} question types.

s2.title: Configure
s2.text: Add logic, scoring, quotas and translations.

s3.title: Collect
s3.text: Share the form and preserve respondent progress with autosaved attempts.

s4.title: Analyze
s4.text: Explore funnels, distributions, journeys and export your data.

cta.title: Ready to build smarter forms?
cta.text: Create dynamic surveys, deliver personalized experiences and understand every respondent journey with Quorvia.
cta.note: Build forms that go beyond traditional surveys.

footer.tagline: Dynamic forms for thoughtful questions, meaningful outcomes and clearer decisions.
footer.slogan: Build forms that think beyond questions.
